description.value: Glorious Bao & Fried Rice is a food-court Taiwanese restaurant founded in 2019 by alumni of a Michelin-starred kitchen, specializing in handmade soup dumplings, gua bao, and wok-fried rice dishes made to order. Located on the second floor of a Burnaby mall, it has earned a loyal following for delivering restaurant-quality food at food-court prices. A touring cyclist looking for a quick, substantial hot meal will find generous portions and a frequently praised egg fried rice.
